title: Lead Developer
description:
Looking for a workplace for the future?

We are looking for a Lead developer for our Online Sales team, enabling all digital sales journeys on Telenor.se. You will guide and lead highly skilled developers operating in a complex landscape; balancing team growth, AI adoption, technical evolution, and customer experience improvements. We are looking for someone who holds a deep conceptual understanding of frontend software development, but you will also be expected to do hands-on work yourself. We believe the correct person for this role and team is both a leader, mentor and a doer.

How you’ll make a difference with us

  • Leadership: You will be accountable for the technical excellence of the team, including code quality. However, there are many ways to lead and at Telenor we promote strength-based leadership and servant leadership.

  • Team Management & Growth: At Telenor we believe we are Better Together. You're expected to help your colleagues learn and grow, for example through individual feedback, mentoring and pair programming.

  • Stability & reliability: Telenor provides services that are vital for our society. Because of this an important responsibility for this role to ensure stable, resilient and secure platforms.

  • In-team collaboration: You'll be one of the informal leaders of the team, together with the Agile Team Lead and the Product Owner, whom you'll be expected to collaborate closely with.

  • Cross-team collaboration: You'll work closely with architects, UX, content creators and other development teams.

Are you the one we’re looking for?

We are looking for someone comfortable working with most of our current technologies, who can work within our architectural principles and help evolve them through thoughtful discussion and practical experience. We are looking for someone familiar with the following technologies.

Frontend Development

  • Strong expertise in TypeScript, JavaScript and frontend frameworks (e.g. Vue).

  • Microfrontend architectures and components patterns.

  • Design Systems, component libraries.

  • Responsive design and browser compatibility.

Backend Development

  • Strong expertise in .NET/C# web application development.

  • Third-party system integrations (REST APIs and GraphQL).

  • Headless CMS architecture (Contentful).

Testing & Quality

  • TDD and quality-first development.

  • Clean code, maintainability and engineering best practices.

Cloud, DevOps & Observability

  • Cloud platforms (AWS).

  • Distributed caching strategies (Redis).

  • CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).

  • Observability and performance analysis (ELK, Splunk, Elastic APM).

Accessibility

  • WCAG, semantic HTML and inclusive design.

  • Accessibility testing and compliance.

Security

  • Security best practices.

  • Secure coding and privacy by design.

Good-to-have

  • E-commerce and digital sales flows.

  • Feature management and experimentation platforms.

  • AI-assisted software development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code).

Our promise to you!

We are better together. Here, you’ll join an inclusive, family-like culture where shared values and empowering leadership build trust, confidence, and mutual support.

We support relationships and societies. Telenor serves society by creating value for millions daily, putting customers and human relationships first.

We make room for life. Work remotely up to two days a week when your role allows, and collaborate at the office otherwise. Enjoy two extra days off yearly, flexible hours, and benefits for every life stage, including collective agreements, pensions, wellness allowances, and tailored insurance.

Move your career forward. Your growth is central to our culture. We dedicate at least 40 hours yearly to learning through Telenor Academy and other initiatives, helping you build expertise, explore new areas, and advance your career across the Nordics.

Apply today!

At Telenor we offer an environment with a high pace of change, great colleagues and lots of opportunities for learning and growth. Apply now!

If you have any questions or want to know more, feel free to contact the hiring manager Jakob Grefbäck at jakob.grefback@telenor.se . Please note that we cannot accept applications via email.

title: Solution Architect
description:
Looking for a workplace for the future?

At Telenor, you own your career. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make the most of your dreams and expertise while contributing to technological innovations that are barely even imagined today. Innovations that we know will change the way we communicate and live our connected lives in the future.

We are now looking for a Solution Architect to join our Strategy & Architecture team in Karlskrona.

How you'll make a difference with us

As a Solution Architect, you'll play a key role in shaping the technology solutions that support Telenor's future business and customer experiences. Working at the intersection of business and technology, you'll help transform complex challenges into secure, scalable, and sustainable solutions.

You'll be part of the Strategy & Architecture team and collaborate closely with business stakeholders, Enterprise Architects, development teams, and external partners. From early discovery and design through implementation, you'll help guide initiatives that modernize our digital landscape and create long-term value for both customers and the business.

In this role, you will:

  • Translate business needs into robust technology solutions

  • Shape solution architecture across complex business and technology domains

  • Drive modernization of our IT and digital landscape

  • Guide teams from concept and design through implementation

  • Balance customer value, business priorities, security, cost, and long-term sustainability

  • Ensure alignment with architecture principles and strategic direction

Your work will contribute to creating simpler, smarter, and more reliable digital experiences, helping our customers stay connected in a safe way.

Are you the one we're looking for?

We need someone who's always on their toes! You have a genuine desire to learn and develop so we can continue to meet our customers' ever-changing needs, today and tomorrow.

You're an architect who enjoys connecting strategy, business, and technology. You understand that the best solutions are not always the most complex ones, and you're comfortable influencing decisions across teams and stakeholder groups.

We believe you bring:

  • Experience designing end-to-end solutions in complex IT environments

  • The ability to communicate architecture and technical decisions in a clear and engaging way

  • Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills

  • A pragmatic mindset with the ability to balance big-picture thinking with attention to detail

  • A university degree or equivalent practical experience

  • Professional proficiency in English

It's a bonus if you also have experience with:

  • Telecommunications and digital services

  • BSS/OSS environments

  • Cloud platforms and cloud-native technologies

  • APIs, integrations, and microservices

  • AI technologies and emerging digital capabilities

  • Security architecture and secure-by-design principles

Most importantly, you're curious, adaptable, and motivated by solving problems, learning new things and helping shape the future of technology at Telenor.

Our promise to you!

We are better together. Here, you'll be part of a family-like and inclusive culture, built on strong shared values and leadership that empowers you with both trust and confidence. We believe in enabling each other to act and make decisions, while always having each other's backs through ups and downs.

We support relationships and societies. Telenor plays a vital role in society, giving your work a greater purpose. Every day, we create value for millions of people and maintain a customer-first approach where human relationships are at the heart of everything we do.

We make room for life. Work from home up to two days a week, if your role allows it. The rest of the time, we create magic together at the office. You also get two "give-me-a-break" days per year for extra time off, and our flexible working hours help you balance your time. We support you through every stage of life with our benefit package, including collective agreements, occupational pensions, wellness allowances, and customized insurance solutions tailored to your needs.

We invite you to a career in motion. Your development is at the center of our culture. We dedicate at least 40 hours per year to deepening your expertise, exploring new areas, and developing your role. Through Telenor Academy and other learning initiatives, you'll have the tools and freedom to advance your career. If you want to broaden your horizons, we are present throughout the Nordics.

Apply today!

title: Clinical Evaluator
description:
Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries.

The position

As a Clinical Evaluator at Cambio, you will play an important role in ensuring that our medical devices are supported by robust clinical evidence and meet applicable requirements for clinical safety and performance.

You will independently plan and conduct clinical evaluations while working closely with a cross-functional Clinical Evaluation Team combining expertise in the device, its intended use and the relevant clinical area. You will collaborate with colleagues across Regulatory Affairs, Risk Management, Post-Market Surveillance, R&D, Product Management and Marketing.

The role gives you the opportunity to work across the medical device lifecycle and contribute to both regulatory compliance and the continued development of our clinical evaluation processes.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Plan, conduct and maintain clinical evaluations throughout the medical device lifecycle

  • Develop and maintain Clinical Evaluation Plans and Clinical Evaluation Reports

  • Conduct systematic literature reviews and critically assess clinical data and scientific evidence

  • Evaluate clinical safety, performance and benefit-risk, integrating evidence from risk management, verification and validation, usability and other relevant activities

  • Monitor emerging clinical evidence, identify residual clinical uncertainties and recommend, develop and conduct appropriate Post-Market Clinical Follow-up activities

  • Support regulatory submissions and interactions with notified bodies


We offer:

  • The opportunity to work with state-of-the-art medical software that helps shape the future of healthcare

  • Challenging and evolving clinical work as new technologies, including AI, raise the bar for clinical evidence, safety and performance

  • The chance to influence how clinical evaluations are conducted at Cambio and contribute to the continued development of our clinical strategy


About you

You have a strong scientific and analytical mindset and are comfortable working with complex clinical information and turning it into clear, well-founded conclusions.

You are quality-conscious and attentive to detail, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of your responsibilities. At the same time, you enjoy working as part of a team and collaborating with people from different areas of expertise. You are a clear and adaptable communicator, able to explain complex topics in a simple and understandable way depending on your audience.

At Cambio, we value initiative and personal growth. Our culture is built on Trust, Care and Together, and it is important that you recognize yourself in these values.

Requirements 

  • Experience working with clinical evaluation of medical devices, either leading or contributing to the clinical evaluation process

  • Experience working with the EU Medical Device Regulation (MDR) and relevant guidance documents

  • Experience in systematic literature reviews and critical appraisal of clinical and scientific data

  • Good understanding of clinical safety, performance and benefit-risk assessment

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and good communication skills in Swedish

It's a bonus if you

  • Have experience working with medical device software

  • Have experience with Post-Market Surveillance (PMS), Post-Market Clinical Follow-up (PMCF) or risk management

  • Have experience with clinical research methodology, clinical investigation design or biostatistics

  • Have experience assessing state of the art, benchmark devices or equivalence

  • Have experience with scientific literature databases such as Embase or Medline

Additional information:

Place of employment: Linköping or Stockholm

Scope: Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office)

Form of employment: Permanent employment, 6 months trial period

Additional Information: The role involves access to sensitive information, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate.

We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible via the link.

We look forward to receiving your application!

CAMBIO- FOR A HEALTHIER TOMORROW

Welcome to a company where healthcare is improved every day. Here you will work with leading technology in a collaborative, trusting and empowering environment where your contribution will be appreciated and celebrated. In our caring culture you will have the opportunity to pursue different paths of professional growth. Seize the opportunity to do the most important work of your life. Read more about us here!

title: Senior AML Specialist - fokus modeller och riskhantering
description:
Trivs du bäst när du får utveckla helheten och driva komplexa AML-frågor från idé till verklighet? Som senior AML Specialist på NOBA får du ett stort eget ansvar för våra AML-processer, riskbedömningar och modeller. Du driver arbetet självständigt, vägleder kollegor och seniora beslutsfattare samt hjälper banken att balansera regulatoriska krav med verksamhetens behov. Rollen är både strategisk och operativ: du sätter process och metod, men går också djupt ner i data och utför analyser.

Vi är ett erfaret AML-team där kunskap delas generöst och diskussionerna är öppna. Tillsammans ser vi till att NOBA lever upp till regelverken och står stadigt i en föränderlig omvärld. Dina närmaste kollegor kommer bestå av AML-specialister och analytiker men du arbetar även nära våra AML-utredare och deras Team Managers. Group Head of AML ansvarar för AML-verksamheten i Sverige och på vår filial Bank Norwegian vars medarbetare du kommer att ha nära samarbete med.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

I rollen driver du AML-arbetet självständigt, med fokus på modeller och riskbedömningar. Du kommer bland annat att:

  • Utveckla våra AML/CTF-modeller för transaktionsövervakning, kundscreening och kundriskklassificering, inklusive viktning, testning och dokumentation av modellernas uppbyggnad och funktion i samarbete med modellansvarig

  • Leda arbetet med att översätta den verksamhetsövergripande riskbedömningen (BWRA) till modeller, och presentera slutsatser för seniora intressenter

  • Vara go-to-expert i komplexa AML-frågor och stötta seniora beslutsfattare med råd och underlag

  • Driva samarbetet med compliance, risk, juridik och projektteam, leda större AML-projekt och omsätta nya AML-trender till handling

  • Utforma och leda utbildningar kring modellerna för kundriskklassificering, TM-regler och kundscreening

  • Hålla dig uppdaterat om regelförändringar och leda arbetet gentemot Compliance, Internrevision och tillsynsmyndigheter

Vem vi söker

Du är trygg i din specialistkompetens och van att driva komplexa frågor självständigt, men uppskattar att ha kollegor att utbyta idéer med bolla med. Du delar gärna med dig av kunskap, coachar andra och vågar utmana. Du tar ansvar och driver framåt med struktur och pragmatism.

Utöver detta söker vi dig som:

  • Har en kandidatexamen eller högre inom finans, företagsekonomi, statistik, matematik eller ekonomisk statistik, redovisning eller annan relevant utbildning

  • Har flerårig erfarenhet (+5) av kvalificerat AML-arbete

  • Har djup förståelse kring hur BWRA och modellriskhantering hänger ihop

  • Har avancerad kompetens i att översätta affärskrav till IT-leveranser

  • Har en analytisk förmåga att se mönster och hur dessa påverkar modellerna

  • Har erfarenhet av att självständigt leda AML-projekt och processer

  • Har förmåga att balansera regulatoriska krav med affärsnytta och omsätta regelverk till praktiskt fungerande lösningar

  • Talar och skriver obehindrat på både svenska och engelska

Det är meriterande om du

  • Är diplomerad inom AML, till exempel från ICA eller ACAMS

  • Har erfarenhet från ett finansiellt institut likt Nordax

  • Har arbetat med både privat- och företagskunder

title: IT Governance Lead
description:
Ready to build something from the ground up? As our first IT Governance Lead, you’ll get a clear mandate to shape how IT Operations handles risk, compliance and control. You’ll bring structure where it matters most, make everyday work easier for many colleagues and set the standard for the future. Your work will reduce manual effort and strengthen our regulatory standing as a bank, and you’ll influence how we govern IT for many years to come.

We are IT Operations at NOBA. As a bank, we work under continuous audit scrutiny and evolving regulatory demands, including DORA. That’s why we’re now establishing a dedicated IT Governance function to bring structure, alignment and scalability to how we manage compliance, risk and asset governance. You’ll report to the Head of IT Operations and work closely with all our domain leads.


About the role:
As IT Governance Lead, you’ll combine strategic ownership with hands-on delivery: you set the direction, own the outcomes and dive into the detail when needed. You’ll be the go-to person for governance across IT Operations, reporting to the Head of IT Operations.

Your main responsibilities:

  • Build and implement a structured Governance, Risk and Compliance operating model

  • Manage and implement new regulations affecting IT Operations

  • Coordinate recurring obligations such as DR testing, exit plan testing and policy renewals, so nothing critical is missed

  • Drive audit finding management, from identification through remediation and evidence

  • Lead and facilitate AI governance

  • Develop the asset and license governance framework, setting the standard and consolidating the overall view

  • Manage the IT Operations risk control register together with relevant legal, compliance and risk organizations, to ensure controls are reviewed and updated continuously

Who we're looking for:
You enjoy building and creating order where none exists yet. You’re structured, curious, take initiative and find it easy to collaborate and build trust with many different colleagues. With your commitment, you help people pull in the same direction.

In addition, we’re looking for you who:

  • Have experience in IT governance, risk or compliance, ideally within financial services or another regulated industry

  • Are familiar with DORA, GDPR or comparable regulatory frameworks

  • Have a builder’s mindset and are comfortable establishing structure where little currently exists, rather than maintaining an established function

  • Have strong stakeholder management skills and enjoy working closely with every domain lead in IT Operations

  • Have experience with GRC tooling, which is a plus, though your first task will be building the operating model itself

title: Head of Credit Data
description:
Ready to shape the data foundation that every credit decision at NOBA rests on? As Head of Credit Data, you’ll decide what data we buy, what we build and what good looks like – so that scorecards, credit rules, analytics and AI tools run on the best input. It’s a role with real weight, and a rare chance to work on what may be the largest credit-relevant dataset in the Nordics.


About the role:
We are Credit & Analytics, the team behind every credit decision across all our markets and brands – the logic, process, software and analytics that handle about 25 million applications per year. Credit data is the raw material for all of it, from scorecards and pricing to our AI tools. We’re rewiring how we work, and we need someone exceptional to own the data side of that journey. As Head of Credit Data, you own the data that powers credit granting: which sources we use, what we require of them, what they cost and how they’re made available. You sit between the credit business and our data engineers, translating between the two.

Your main responsibilities include:

  • Setting the requirements for, and structure of, our credit data – quality, coverage, lineage and timeliness – so it can be used for scorecards, credit rules, analytics and AI tools, with a clear view of what good looks like

  • Helping teams across NOBA further increase the return on our data

  • Owning our agreements with credit bureaus and external data providers across multiple countries, with overall responsibility for optimising our Credit Information Costs, a budget of around 100 MSEK

  • Working closely with the credit business to prioritise what matters most, and turning that into concrete deliveries for the data engineering team

  • Providing strategic leadership for the NOBA Credit Data function and driving the development of its people, capabilities and ways of working

Who we’re looking for
You’re analytical and structured, with a clear view of what good looks like and the drive to get there. You find novel solutions to complex problems, build strong relationships and listen to turn ambiguous asks into precise requirements. Your satisfaction comes from moving the needle.

On top of this, we’re looking for you who have:

  • An M.Sc. or equivalent from a demanding field, with university-level mathematics and strong analytical judgment

  • Expert-level knowledge of the Nordic credit data market, with hands-on experience of bureau datasets for prediction – ideally the full process of scanning, acquiring, negotiating and implementing credit-relevant data, then building models and tracking performance

  • Senior experience in banking and/or consumer credit, with a deep understanding of how credit data feeds models, rules and analytics

  • Proven software development skills, including managing larger software projects end to end, and advanced use of AI development tools

  • Experience driving initiatives in complex stakeholder environments, bridging business and engineering, and communicating clearly with both technical and senior audiences

We’re early in rewiring how credit is underwritten with modern data and AI tooling, so this is a chance to set the standard rather than inherit one. If you want to create something truly outstanding at the core of banking, we’d love to hear from you.


In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead.

title: Data Engineer
description:
As a Data Engineer in NOBA Bank Group, you'll turn raw data into structured, high-quality assets that the whole organization can use. You'll build and evolve our data platform and help the bank innovate and grow through reliable, accessible data.

About the role:
The Data & Analytics Engineering department brings together specialists in data infrastructure, analytics, and data management. Together we build a modern and reliable data foundation that supports decision making across the business. This role is in the Data Management & New Initiatives team.

You'll design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and data models on Databricks and dbt. You'll work with colleagues across the bank to understand business needs and translate them into well-designed, scalable data solutions. From ingesting new sources to modelling data for analytics and reporting, you'll own the work end to end and see the impact of what you build.

We use AI extensively in our daily work, from writing and reviewing code to documentation and analysis. You'll be encouraged to use AI tools to work faster and smarter, and to help us find new ways to apply them.

This is a great opportunity to enjoy a high degree of self-responsibility and to expand your expertise into areas of your interest. You'll collaborate broadly and see the tangible results of your work.

We offer a hybrid working model with two common in-office days. While we value flexibility, we also prioritize collaboration, team building, and enjoying fikas and after work gatherings together!

Main tasks:

  • Design, build, and maintain data pipelines using Databricks and dbt

  • Develop and maintain data models that make data easy to understand and use for analytics and reporting

  • Integrate new data sources and transform data from ingestion through to consumption.

  • Optimize pipeline performance, scalability, and cost

  • Apply version control and CI/CD practices to deploy changes safely and efficiently

  • Use AI tools to speed up development, testing, and documentation, while applying sound judgment on quality and security

  • Collaborate with analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver data that meets real needs

  • Ensure data quality, security, and compliance throughout the data lifecycle

  • Document solutions and contribute to best practices


We are looking for you who:
Enjoys building well-structured, reliable data solutions and is curious about new technologies and modern data engineering practices. You like understanding the "why" behind a business need and turning it into something practical and scalable.

You're proactive and detail-oriented, you thrive in collaborative environments, and you approach challenges with a "can-do" mindset. You value a high degree of self-responsibility and are motivated to grow in the areas that interest you. You're open to using AI as part of how you work and stay curious about how it changes modern data engineering.

For this role, you'll need:

  • Experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role

  • Fluency in English, along with fluency in either Swedish or Norwegian

  • An academic degree in a relevant field such as data engineering, computer science, or a related discipline

  • Practical experience with both Databricks and dbt in a production environment

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and in ETL/ELT processes, with a solid understanding of how data is sourced, transformed, and delivered to end users

  • Experience with data modelling (e.g., dimensional modelling, medallion architectures)

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure's data stack

  • Solid understanding of version control systems and CI/CD tools

It's positive if you:

  • Python experience

  • Familiarity with AI tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar) and a pragmatic, curious approach to using them in your work

  • Previous experience in data-focused roles within the financial sector

  • Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies

  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code

Our offer to you

  • Freedom with responsibility: Flexible working arrangements to suit your work style and a high degree of self-responsibility

  • Career development: Opportunities to grow and develop in your role, and to expand your expertise into areas of your interest

  • Feedback culture: A supportive environment that encourages open communication

  • Coaching leadership: Managers who guide and support your career journey

  • A caring company culture: We genuinely care about each other!

You'll also have the chance to work with cutting-edge data technologies and be part of shaping the future of NOBA's data landscape.

It's important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead.

description:
Trivs du med siffror, struktur och att säkerställa hög kvalitet i varje detalj? Som låneförvaltare inom hypotekslån med kapitalfrigöringskredit får du en central roll där du kombinerar analytiskt tänkande med kundfokus. Du ansvarar för att våra lån hanteras korrekt bidrar till en effektiv och tillförlitlig låneförvaltning.

Svensk Hypotekspension är specialiserat på hypotekspension - en kapitalfrigöringskredit som låter personer över 60 år att låna med bostaden som säkerhet utan att amortera eller betala ränta löpande. På så vis kan kunden frigöra pengar ur sitt hem utan att sälja och flytta, och utan att vardagsekonomin påverkas.

Om rollen:
Som låneförvaltare ansvarar du för den löpande förvaltningen och administrationen av in- och utbetalningar, där noggrannhet och ett gott sifferhuvud är avgörande. Din vardag är omväxlande och består av förbereda och genomföra dagliga utbetalningar av beviljade lån med rätt säkerhet på plats, hantera pantbrev och avslut av lån. Du sköter registervård av lånereskontran, gör löpande avstämningar och kontrollerar att siffrorna stämmer.

Rollen kombinerar det noggranna sifferarbetet med en god servicekänsla. Du ska motiveras av administrativa arbetsuppgifter. En del av din tid lägger du på att besvara frågor från kunder, mäklare och andra banker via telefon och e-post. Du hanterar allt från transaktioner kopplade till nya kunder till befintliga kunders skulder och lån, och säkerställer att rätt information finns på plats när det krävs.


Huvudsakliga uppgifter:

  • Ansvara för den löpande förvaltningen och administrationen av bolån med säkerhet i fastighet eller bostadsrätt.

  • Säkerställa en korrekt och effektiv hantering av låneärenden, från utbetalning till avslut.

  • Ge god service och vägledning till våra kunder

  • Hantera och följa upp förändringar i låneengagemang samt säkerställa att arbetet utförs i enlighet med gällande regelverk, interna riktlinjer och processer.

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Har arbetat med privatlån, bolån eller andra krediter

  • Har erfarenhet av service, administrativt arbete och arbete via telefon

  • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift

Vi ser det som positivt om du har arbetat med pantbrev och säkerheter.

En lagspelare som är noggrann med öga för detaljer, du vet att det är just precisionen som gör skillnad och du trivs i en roll där ditt kvalitetsfokus får komma till sin fulla rätt. Du är analytisk och får energi av siffror; du har intresse för transaktionsflöden, gör avstämningar och har en känsla för när något behöver en extra titt. Du är även kundfokuserad och tycker om mötet med människor. Du är också strukturerad skapar du enkelt ordning och överblick över ditt arbete och trivs med administrativa arbetsuppgifter.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
We’re looking for a Cloud Engineer who enjoys working in the space where developers and infrastructure meet. Here, you’ll spend your time automating the mundane, architecting the complex, and scaling the future of our Azure AI and OpenAI offerings. This role is for you if you find more joy in writing a PowerShell script to solve a recurring app error than in managing a cluster’s networking.

This is a code-centric role where infrastructure is treated as a software product. Everything you build is versioned, reviewed, tested, and continuously improved. Our goal is to reduce repetitive work and create the “Golden Paths” that let developers and AI teams deploy quickly, securely, and reliably. 

About the role:
As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll help build and grow our Azure-based platform. You’ll own the design, automation, and delivery of modular cloud infrastructure, ensuring it’s resilient, scalable, and easy for teams to use. Your work will reduce friction, remove unnecessary steps, and make it simple for developers and data teams to focus on building features instead of worrying about infrastructure.

What you’ll do: 

  • Build the "Golden Path" Pipelines: You won't just "run" pipelines; you will architect them. You’ll design and maintain CI/CD templates (YAML-based) that standardize how our applications are built, tested, and deployed. Your goal is to make the path from code-complete to production-ready as invisible and frictionless as possible for our developers.

  • Automated Application Remediation: We don't believe in manual maintenance. You will use PowerShell and Azure DevOps to build automated pipelines for things like patching the container OS, reporting on deviations and self healing infrastructure

  • Infrastructure as Versioned Code: You’ll design and implement modular Azure infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), following the Azure Well-Architected Framework for reliability, performance, and cost.

We are looking for you who have:

  • Expert-level PowerShell skills: We operate in an environment where automation is built on PowerShell first. (Bash & Python are secondary)

  • Proven experience with Azure Bicep: You should be comfortable treating infrastructure as a software product, versioning, testing and modularizing Bicep code.

  • Developer-centric approach: You don't need to be a fullstack developer, but you need to understand application logic enough to automate patching, troubleshoot database connections, and optimize application performance within the cloud.

  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).

You’ll be comfortable owning tasks end to end and making technical decisions independently within the areas listed above. Ideally, you have some years of hands-on experience with Azure, containers, and CI/CD pipelines, but we care more about what you can do and that you enjoy the field, rather than the exact number of years. 

It's positive if you have: 

  • Active Azure certifications such as AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer), AZ-305 (Solutions Architect), AZ-204 (Developer Associate)

  • Experience from regulated or security-conscious environments is a plus 

In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead.

More than any single skill, we're looking for curiosity, and a habit of explaining your work so that others can follow it. If you've used Git and code review, or you know your way around model validation and documentation requirements, you'll feel at home quickly. If not, you'll learn.

You'll be joining a team of four senior analysts, led by Dácil Hernández, who genuinely enjoy sharing what they know. Mentoring isn't an afterthought here; colleagues invest real time in it. You won't be expected to know everything on day one. Questions are welcome, and from early on you'll have real ownership of your work.
